universities.summary: CIPET IPT Chennai is a government technical institute at Guindy Industrial Estate. Its first-year engineering routes include Plastics Technology and Manufacturing Engineering, alongside a wider campus portfolio in polymer science, design and technical training. Laboratory-based study and industrially focused facilities distinguish this specialist Chennai centre.
universities.campusLifestyle: Laboratories for processing, testing, mould-related work and computer-aided design sit alongside classrooms, a library, digital resources, cafeteria and hostels. The campus profile combines academic teaching with technical training rather than a broad multi-faculty university portfolio.
universities.cityProfile: The centre is at Thiru Vi-Ka Industrial Estate in Guindy, Chennai. Its campus page identifies nearby Ekkatuthangal Metro and Guindy suburban rail connections. The profile is limited to this Chennai centre: CIPET’s national navigation also lists many other centres, which must not be treated as additional Chennai campuses or programme locations.
universities.practicalExposure: The Chennai academic materials feature processing and testing laboratories, computer-aided design resources and library facilities for polymer-related study. The programme mix connects plastics technology, mould design and manufacturing with applied laboratory work. Training and placement services form part of the institutional provision, but a recruiter list or previous graduate outcome is not a guaranteed internship or job for a new applicant.
universities.hostelOverview: The Chennai prospectus describes separate boys’ and girls’ hostels for outstation students within the campus, with water, power backup and round-the-clock security. Accommodation charges and mess advances are additional to academic tuition; a place should be confirmed directly.
universities.dietarySupport: The campus has a cafeteria and hostel mess arrangements, with mess advances shown separately in the prospectus. Specific dietary or allergy provision is not established in the reviewed documents and should be confirmed before residence.
universities.safetyOverview: The hostel provision includes round-the-clock security according to the current prospectus. This describes an institutional service, not a guarantee of personal safety; applicants should ask the centre for current emergency and grievance contacts.
universities.studentSupport: The admissions materials identify programme contacts and the appropriate counselling or direct-application route. Library, digital-library and training-and-placement provision support academic work and preparation for the next stage of study or employment. faq.question: Where is this CIPET centre located?
faq.answer: This profile concerns CIPET IPT at Thiru Vi-Ka Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai. It does not combine programmes from CIPET’s other centres. The campus identifies nearby Ekkatuthangal Metro and Guindy suburban-rail connections.

faq.question: Which engineering routes are detailed here?
faq.answer: The supported first-year academic routes are four-year B.Tech Plastics Technology and B.E. Manufacturing Engineering, through TNEA college code 1321. Other campus awards and lateral-entry modes have separate requirements.

faq.question: What independent affiliation and current course evidence is available?
faq.answer: Anna University’s own affiliated-college roster lists the Chennai centre with examination code 3103 and TNEA code 1321. DTE’s 2026 directory records approved intake for both UG branches, and its current counselling matrix names PA Plastics Technology and MN Manufacturing Engineering. This is not a claim that a separate 2026–27 AICTE EoA was retrieved.

faq.question: What academic qualification is required?
faq.answer: The academic route requires a pass in HSC +1 and +2 or an accepted equivalent, with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. TNEA uses a 45% PCM average for General and 40% for the stated eligible reserved categories. Minimum marks do not assure allotment.

faq.question: Is there an age restriction?
faq.answer: The 2026–27 CIPET prospectus states an age limit of 21 for first-year undergraduate entry. It does not identify the calculation date, so an applicant near the limit needs the centre’s cycle-specific clarification.

faq.question: Can applicants from outside Tamil Nadu use TNEA?
faq.answer: Only the listed nativity, Tamil Nadu schooling or parent-service exceptions apply; an Indian passport alone is not enough. The programme entries state the exact categories and conditional employer, schooling and nativity records.

faq.question: Can OCI or PIO applicants apply through this route?
faq.answer: The verified TNEA exception covers Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders under Open Category and excludes those born abroad after 4 March 2021. This does not establish an unrestricted foreign or separate NRI quota.

faq.question: What is the Sri Lankan Tamil refugee route?
faq.answer: Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu may participate under Open Competition with Headquarters Tahsildar identification. Those outside camp registration additionally need their original passport, visa and police-station registration letter.

faq.question: How should the tuition amounts be read?
faq.answer: The first-year 2026–27 prospectus quotes standard annual tuition of INR 55,000 for B.Tech Plastics and INR 50,000 for B.E. Manufacturing. It does not separately identify the OCI/PIO/refugee tariff. Development, university, admission, hostel and mess charges are additional; request a category-specific full-cost plan.

faq.question: Is accommodation available?
faq.answer: The prospectus describes separate on-campus hostels for men and women, with water, power backup and round-the-clock security. Room allocation and hostel/mess charges require separate confirmation; academic tuition does not cover them.

faq.question: Are these admissions currently open?
faq.answer: The verified rules concern the 2026 counselling cycle. They do not establish a currently vacant seat or a future application window; follow the next specifically announced counselling dates.

faq.question: Are lateral entry and postgraduate study the same application?
faq.answer: No. The current portfolio also contains separately advertised lateral-entry, postgraduate and diploma routes. Their exact eligibility, applicant categories and approvals must be checked individually rather than copied from the two first-year engineering routes.

restrictions: This listing covers only first-year academic-stream TNEA seats surrendered by CIPET Chennai, not an independently verified foreign/NRI quota or lateral-entry route.
Indian applicants must satisfy one of the six TNEA nativity, Tamil Nadu schooling or parent-service categories detailed below; an Indian passport alone is insufficient.

Tamil Nadu candidates who passed Classes VIII–XII in Tamil Nadu may apply without a nativity certificate. Tamil Nadu natives who studied any of those classes outside the state require a digitally signed nativity certificate.

Children of Central Government employees qualify irrespective of nativity if a parent—or guardian only where both parents are deceased—served continuously in Tamil Nadu for five years; employer evidence is required.

Children of permanent public-sector or government-recognised-institution employees qualify irrespective of domicile with five continuous years of Tamil Nadu employment and the specified employer/supporting records.
Children of All India Service Tamil Nadu-cadre officers require a parental declaration. Other-state candidates who studied Classes VIII–XII in Tamil Nadu may apply without a nativity certificate.
The parent-service and other-state schooling categories are considered under Open Competition; communal reservation requires Tamil Nadu nativity and the prescribed state community certificate.
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders may participate under Open Category, except those born in a foreign country after 4 March 2021. Do not broaden this to every OCI/PIO or foreign applicant.

Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu may participate under Open Competition with Headquarters Tahsildar identification; those outside refugee-camp registration also need original passport, visa and police-registration letter.
audienceEligibility.notes: TNEA 2026 explicitly names CIPET Chennai among participating central-government institutions. NRI residence alone neither creates a verified NRI quota nor negates eligibility as an Indian national under these rules.
